# Welcome to #🥟-bio
This channel is for **BIO**, the Bao I/O coprocessor from bunnie's Baochip-1x, and work on improving it. @bunnie and @Xobs look after this channel.

**On wafer.space**
- [DPK1 bio180](<https://wafer.space/ws-run2/projects/DPK1.html>) (Run 2, 0.5x1 slot): dual core BIO with 4 KB of SRAM and an SPI host on GF180MCU, by Deepak Sharda. Source: [bio-core](<https://github.com/dpks2003/bio-core>)

**Read first**
- [BIO: The Bao I/O Coprocessor](<https://www.bunniestudios.com/blog/2026/bio-the-bao-i-o-coprocessor/>)
- [Baochip](<https://baochip.com/>): chip, docs, tools and hardware

**Source**
- [baochip-1x](<https://github.com/baochip/baochip-1x>): the chip source
- [bio-sim](<https://github.com/baochip/bio-sim>): RTL simulation of the BIO CPU
- [bio-loader](<https://github.com/baochip/bio-loader>): load BIO code onto a Dabao board

Post your BIO code, simulation results, bring-up results and ideas for improving the design here.
